# Daily Report — 2026-09-29

## Task Completed
Added `create_kb_category` tool to `knowledge_base.py`. Unlike the existing
`create_category` tool, this implementation automatically resolves both the
knowledge base and the optional parent category by name or sys_id before
POSTing to the `kb_category` table. A new `CreateKBCategoryParams` Pydantic
model exposes `name`, `knowledge_base`, `parent`, `active`, and `description`
fields. The tool is registered in the `knowledge_author` and `full` packages.
